paragraphs.text: The proposer commits to providing training for the Owner's operators and maintainers as part of the scope of work. This training will cover the operation, maintenance, and specific procedures relevant to the equipment provided under the respective lots. Training sessions will be conducted on-site and include comprehensive course materials tailored to the equipment and systems delivered.

Regarding the requirement for a regional support center, the proposer acknowledges partial compliance. Support for the equipment and systems will be provided through established service organizations, which include English-speaking staff. The proposer will confirm whether the regional support center meets all specified criteria, including duration of operation, client references, and staffing levels.

The proposer will name specific experts with at least three years of experience in their respective roles to fulfill the requirements of the RFP. These roles include systems architect, systems engineer, data center infrastructure specialist, application and benchmarking specialist, and project manager. The proposer will ensure that each role is covered by a different individual with the requisite experience.

The proposer confirms that the composition of the bidding group will remain unchanged between submission and award. Furthermore, the group leader will provide at least one reference to support the proposal, ensuring compliance with the RFP requirements.
